title: CPF Module Schema: Express route circuit module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-expressroutecircuit'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

allow_classic_operations.description: (Optional) Allow the circuit to interact with classic (RDFE) resources.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

authorization_key_name.description: (Optional) The name of the ExpressRoute circuit authorization.

bandwidth_in_gbps.description: (Optional) The bandwidth in Gbps of the circuit being created on the Express Route Port.

bandwidth_in_mbps.description: (Required) The bandwidth in Mbps of the circuit being created on the Service Provider.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

express_route_port_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Express Route Port this Express Route Circuit is based on. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

peering_location.description: (Required) The name of the peering location and not the Azure resource location. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

service_provider_name.description: (Required) The name of the ExpressRoute Service Provider. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

sku.description: (Required) A sku block for the ExpressRoute circuit as documented below. object ({ tier = (Required) The service tier. Possible values are Basic, Local, Standard or Premium. family = (Required) The billing mode for bandwidth. Possible values are MeteredData or UnlimitedData. })

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

authorization_key_id.description: The ID of the ExpressRoute Circuit Authorization.

id.description: The resource ID of the express route circuit.

name.description: The name of the express route circuit.

service_key.description: The string needed by the service provider to provision the ExpressRoute circuit.

service_provider_provisioning_state.description: The ExpressRoute circuit provisioning state from your chosen service provider. Possible values are NotProvisioned, Provisioning, Provisioned, and Deprovisioning.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Expressroutecircuit' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
